name: Albania
summary: Balkan nation on the Adriatic and Ionian seas with mountainous interior terrain. Generates nearly 100% of its domestic electricity from Drin River cascading hydroelectric complexes.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 3.52x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); older diesel vehicle fleet and domestic wood heating in Tirana basin.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; Balkan heatwaves intensify summer drought across Drin watershed.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Mediterranean basin warming rate of +0.42 °C per decade over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.01% share of global emissions; transport and small industrial sector drive total.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Well below European average due to complete absence of domestic coal power generation.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~7,900 km² of beech and oak mountain forests under state moratorium controls.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: World-leading zero-carbon grid: 99.8% of domestic electricity produced by Drin cascade hydropower.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 101 people/km²; urban population fraction is 63.8%.
